description: This file implements the backend logic for handling notifications and subscriptions in the focalboard project, including subscription management, event handling, and notification hints.

classes.name: Backend
classes.description: Provides notification backend functionalities including event handling, subscription management, and notification hints.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Backend with specified parameters.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the notification backend, initializing necessary components.

methods.name: ShutDown
methods.description: Stops the notification backend and flushes logs.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the backend.

methods.name: getBlockUpdateFreq
methods.description: Determines the frequency for block updates, considering environment variable overrides.

methods.name: BlockChanged
methods.description: Handles block change events, manages subscriptions, and triggers notifications.

methods.name: notifySubscribers
methods.description: Triggers notifications for subscribers by updating notification hints.

methods.name: OnMention
methods.description: Handles @mention events by creating subscriptions for mentioned users if permissions allow.
